c1.title: Close of World Space Week Mexico 2026
c1.body: At UPAEP, World Space Week Mexico 2026 came to a close and the Commemorative Rocket was handed over to begin the first Mexico Space Year in the State of Puebla.

c2.title: Manifesto
c2.body: The triple helix calls for a joint effort to develop a new strategy for the State of Puebla.

c3.title: Where the work points
c3.body: Public science, Puebla industry, space tech startups, talent aligned with industry, and links with the country and the world.

c4.title: Three dates
c4.body: The Manifesto is already issued. Adhesion for the signing closes on November 13. The Pact is signed on November 30.

c5.title: What is required is will, not prior experience
c5.body: You write to the Startup and Innovation Cluster, naming a representative and a contribution. The Manifesto does not require resources.

tagline.line1: Puebla is working to build the aerospace value chain.

a1.title: Science outreach
a1.body: Bring space science and technology to the public and awaken scientific vocations.

a2.title: Industry in Puebla
a2.body: Bring Puebla industry into the aerospace value chain.

a3.title: Space Tech entrepreneurship
a3.body: Turn space science and research into technology ventures.

a4.title: Talent and industry
a4.body: Align training and academic capacity with what industry needs.

a5.title: Connection
a5.body: Connect Puebla’s ecosystem with the aerospace sector in Mexico and abroad.

route.title: From the Manifesto to the Pact

d1.body: The Manifesto is issued and the call opens.

d3.body: The Pact is signed and the Coordinating Committee is installed.

adhesion.title: Join the Pact
adhesion.body: Open call to research centers, universities, business organizations, corporations, the private sector, government agencies, and people from Puebla with the interest and capabilities to develop the aerospace sector in the State of Puebla.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: The Pact for the Development of the Aerospace Sector in the State of Puebla brings government, academia, and industry together to build the state’s aerospace value chain. It is signed on November 30, 2026.
faq.q2: What does the Pact work on?
faq.a2: Five lines: science outreach, industry in Puebla, Space Tech entrepreneurship, talent aligned with industry, and links with the aerospace sector in Mexico and abroad.
faq.a3: Research centers, universities, business organizations, corporations, private companies, government agencies, and local initiatives in Puebla with the interest and capacity to develop the aerospace sector.
faq.q4: How do I join the Pact, and until when?
faq.a4: In “Join the pact” you say who is joining, name the representative, and what they bring. The email explains how to write the letter, addressed to the Startup and Innovation Cluster. To be included in the November 30 signing, the signed letter must arrive by November 13, 2026.
faq.a5: The State Government, SEDETRA, SECIHTI Puebla, and CTS; federal Science and Technology with INAOE, UPAEP, BUAP, and Sintonía; World Space Week and REGENIA; the Startup and Innovation Cluster, the Automotive Cluster, CANACINTRA Puebla, and Yankuilotl.
faq.a6: The Pact is signed and the Coordinating Committee is installed. Conveners and those who joined in time take part.
